reviews.title: TOXIC AND HORRIBLE FOR YOUNG, IMPRESSIONAL GIRLS
reviews.text: i’m a 14 year old girl in 8th grade and in my opinion this app is HORRIBLE. it started off all right, it was hard to search for stuff and the videos that were shown were lighthearted and positive. the recent FYP feature has been recommending me HORRIBLY depressingly and influential videos, one of them had the hashtag “#starvingmyself” and made it seem like a positive/normal thing to do at this age. as someone who has gone through mental health stuff because of these apps i find this disgusting. coverstar’s whole advertisement is that it is a safe app for preteens and teenagers, so the fact that they are allowing these types of videos on here is UNACCEPTABLE. coverstar has been tracking that i like anime and kpop, etc. those things tend to be associated with self harm and and suicide for god knows what reason, and because those are the types of videos i like, coverstar is recommending me videos that would make any young girl horribly depressed and suicidal. this NEEDS. TO. END. i am in DISBELIEF that this app is still up and running with all of the disgusting things on it, please for the love of god, fix your app or stop advertising it to children who are easily manipulated, or impressionable. this is disgusting and horrifying. i will absolutely be deleting this app, please do NOT let your child get this app if you want them to have a good and happy life moving forward. thank you.

reviews.title: I thought it would work.
reviews.text: I used this app last summer in 2024, it was really good and I made an account and I had almost 100 followers. But then I got it again on this phone and it started to not work. First thing, When I logged in, it would not let me actually sign in. It said that I had to be 13+ to join. And even though this is a 3+ app, it wouldn’t let me. Then every single maybe six scrolls it would force me to sign up even though it already wouldn’t let me. After I tried to get out of it multiple times just to get a little bit of a glimpse of the outside world, it kept glitching and making me re-log into the app. Whenever I finally did sign up and login it forced me to buy something. After I said, I didn’t want to buy it and I didn’t buy it. It kicked me out of the app for two weeks. The only people I saw was Faye Knightley. And another girl whose name is like Isabella or something. No hate to them, but I’m just tired of only seeing that two people or they’re not enough Nelson’s. If you could try to fix at least one of these problems that would be so great! 😃
